Gaza Strip comprehensive building and housing unit damage assessment
Title in static PDF map: Occupied Palestinian Territory Gaza Strip : imagery analysis 29 February 2024
dct_description_sm: Contributors: United Nations Institute for Training and Research; United Nations Operational Satellite Applications Programme, cartographer
Publication statement: Geneva, Switzerland : United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT), 29 February 2024.

The dataset illustrates a satellite-imagery based comprehensive assessment of damage and destruction to structures within the area of interest in the Gaza Strip, Occupied Palestinian Territory, based on images collected on 29 February 2024 when compared to images collected on 1 May 2023, 10 May 2023, 18 September 2023, 15 October 2023, 7 November 2023, 26 November 2023, and 6-7 January 2024. According to satellite imagery analysis, UNOSAT identified 31,198 destroyed structures, 16,908 severely damaged structures and 40,762 moderately damaged structures, for a total of 88,868 structures. These correspond to around 35% of the total structures in the Gaza Strip and a total of 121,400 estimated damaged housing units.
